run_code_prediction_demo: run the demo CLI to predict next tokens using a trained LSTM code prediction model
predict_next_tokens: predict the top k next tokens for a given Python code token sequence
get_top_predictions: get the top k predicted tokens with softmax probabilities from a model output tensor
demo_sequence_prediction: demo next token prediction on a made-up Python code sequence like file open statements
demo_datapoint_prediction: demo predictions at specific token indices within a raw or converted dataset data point
